Brief Description

Job Overview

Trainonex Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a creative and enthusiastic Graphic Designer Intern to join our team. The candidate will assist in creating engaging visual content for digital marketing campaigns, social media platforms, and promotional activities while gaining practical industry experience.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Design creative social media posts, banners, advertisements, and promotional materials.

  2. Create graphics for digital marketing campaigns across various social media platforms.

  3. Develop creative concepts and layouts in accordance with company branding guidelines.

  4. Collaborate with the digital marketing and content teams to understand design requirements.

  5. Assist in designing brochures, flyers, presentations, and other marketing materials.

  6. Edit and enhance images, illustrations, and other visual assets.

  7. Maintain consistency in design quality, typography, colour schemes, and visual presentation.

  8. Incorporate feedback and make necessary revisions to designs.

  9. Complete assigned design tasks within specified deadlines.

  10. Stay updated with current graphic design trends, tools, and creative techniques.

Benefits

  • Monthly Stipend: ₹3,000

  • Practical exposure to real-time digital marketing and branding projects.

  • Hands-on experience with professional design tools and workflows.

  • Guidance and mentorship from the digital marketing team.

  • Opportunity to develop creative and professional skills.

Preferred Skills

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Basic knowledge of graphic design principles, colour theory, typography, and layout composition.

  • Familiarity with Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Canva, or similar design tools.

  • Creativity and a strong interest in visual communication.

  • Good attention to detail and willingness to learn.

  • Ability to understand creative briefs and work collaboratively.

  • Basic knowledge of social media design requirements will be an added advantage.

  • A portfolio of academic, personal, or professional design projects is preferred.

Eligibility

  • Candidates pursuing or having completed a degree, diploma, or certification in Graphic Design, Multimedia, Visual Communication, or a related field are preferred.

  • Freshers are encouraged to apply.

  • Candidates with a creative mindset and willingness to learn are welcome.
